data.name: Mubeenah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-n-n', meaning 'to clarify, explain, or make evident'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes a person who speaks the truth and is known for their transparency and clarity in communication.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mubeenah is a name given to those who are clear and make things clear for others. It represents the ability to understand complex situations and make them simpler for others to understand. This name is often given to those who are patient, wise, and knowledgeable.
data.numerology_meaning: Represents spirituality, wisdom, and destiny-driven strength.

in_arabic.name: مبينه
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مبينه بمعنى الواضحة أو الظاهرة أو البينة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبينه اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل بين يبين فهو مبين وبين وبينة ومبين ومبينة وهي مبينة ومبينة اسم مبينه بمعنى الواضحة أو الظاهرة أو البينة كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة آية 255 في وصف الله تعالى بأنه مبين

in_urdu.name: مبینہ
in_urdu.meaning: مبینہ کا مطلب واضح یا ظاہر یا بینہ ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبینہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو فعل بین سے مشتق ہے جس کے معنی ہیں واضح کرنا یا ظاہر کرنا یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة البقرة آية 255 میں اللہ تعالی کے وصف کے طور پر آیا ہے جہاں کہا گیا ہے کہ وہی مبین ہے

in_hindi.name: मुबीना
in_hindi.meaning: मुबीना का अर्थ स्पष्ट या प्रकट या प्रमान है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबीना एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो क्रिया बीन से व्युत्पन्न है जिसका अर्थ है स्पष्ट करना या प्रकट करना यह नाम कुरआन में सूरह बक़रा आयत 255 में अल्लाह के विशेषण के रूप में आया है जहां कहा गया है कि वही मुबीना है

in_pashto.name: مبينه
in_pashto.meaning: مبينه د واضحې يا ښکاره يا بينه معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبينه يوه مؤنثه نوم دی چې د بين فعل څخه اخستل شوی دی چې معنی يې ده واضح کول يا ښکاره کول دا نوم د قرآن کريم په سورت البقره آيت 255 کې د الله تعالی د وصف په توګه راغلی دی چیرته چې ویل شوي دي چې هغه مبینه دی

in_english.name: Mubeenah
in_english.meaning: Mubeenah means clear, evident, or manifest in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Mubeenah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'b-y-n' which means to be clear or evident It is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Baqarah, Verse 255, as one of the attributes of Allah, signifying His clarity and manifest nature The name Mubeenah symbolizes transparency, clarity, and spiritual illumination in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mubeenah" carries a rich cultural legacy in the Islamic world. It is a name that holds a high value and respect, especially for communities where clear communication and honesty are desirable virtues. Mubeenah was a title given to the Ahlul Bayt (Prophet Muhammad's family) and they were known for their exemplary character, integrity, and wisdom. In modern times, this name is also a popular choice for children as it embodies the qualities of truthfulness, transparency, and clarity.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Mubeenah" signifies one who is guided by the truth. It represents a person who strives to understand God's message and shares it with others in a clear and succinct manner. In the Quran, Allah (God) says, "And convey as [a form of] wisdom that which was [revealed] to you [Muhammad] and follow not, before their eyes, those who have no knowledge of this [revelation] but only wish to expedite [its execution]." (Quran 31:6)
